result.topic_en: The page computes the Poisson probabilities for the number of chance double stars closer than λ seconds among randomly scattered stars on part of the celestial sphere, followed by a pencil geometric sketch and calculations involving a folded rectangle with angle φ.

methods.what: Expected number of chance close pairs (double stars within λ arcseconds) among randomly distributed stars
Poisson distribution for the number of double stars: probability of n pairs is ω^n e^{-ω}/n!
Mean of the Poisson distribution equals ω
Geometric relation for folded rectangle: x = b − h sin 2φ, y = x tan φ
Expression for maximal y in terms of b, h, φ
